name: mirage
text: Done: parlays now have the wallet. I turned the engine's bid desk off and put the engine's auto-bets on paper, so no new bids or bets use cash (existing positions run to settlement, nothing is sold). That frees the cash that was blocking about 8% of parlay requests. To undo: tell me 'bids and bets back on'. Next I'm measuring, from final scores, which kinds of parlays makers actually profit on, so the engine quotes the winning kinds.
